name: Motor Temperature High Alert
condition_description_id: Suhu motor melebihi 85°C (peringatan dini sebelum interlock Tier 1 di 95°C)
skill_action_steps: Log telemetry event to audit ledger
If temp exceeds 95°C, trigger SAFE-001 immediately

name: Spindle Vibration High Alert
condition_description_id: Getaran spindel melebihi 5 mm/s (peringatan dini sebelum interlock Tier 1 di 8 mm/s)
skill_action_steps: If vibration exceeds 8 mm/s, trigger SAFE-002 immediately

name: Coolant Pressure Low Alert
condition_description_id: Tekanan pendingin mendekati batas minimum (interlock Tier 1 di < 2 bar)
skill_action_steps: If pressure drops below 2 bar, trigger SAFE-003 immediately

name: Scheduled Maintenance Window
condition_description_id: Mesin mendekati slot pemeliharaan yang telah dijadwalkan
skill_action_steps: Identify orders currently on affected work center
Run schedule_solver to find rerouting options
On approval: update SAP schedule, notify operators
At window start: confirm machine is cleared and handed over to maintenance

name: Production Order Late Risk
condition_description_id: Estimasi waktu selesai pesanan melebihi deadline yang dijanjikan ke pelanggan
skill_action_steps: Compute SLA penalty based on order class
Generate Gemini analysis summary in Bahasa Indonesia
If estimated penalty >= escalation_threshold: escalate to supervisor
If estimated penalty < auto_resolve_threshold: auto-apply cheapest scenario
Write all actions to audit ledger
